scene_name: 对比/组合展示 — Comparison & Set Display
emotion: 实用、完整、套装感——展示多色/多规格/全套系
ecommerce_use: 主图 / 详情页 / 规格选择图
prompt: An organized comparison or set display showing multiple variations or components of {{product_name}}. The {{product_category}} is displayed in {{variants_count}} different colorways/options arranged neatly in a row or grid on a clean surface. {{product_description}} Flat lay or arranged display showing the complete set or collection. Each variant is clearly visible with consistent lighting and spacing. Professional catalog-style arrangement. The image helps customers see all available options at a glance. Clean minimalist composition with each product variation getting equal visual weight. {{product_materials}} visible and distinct across variations. Features: {{key_features}}. Perfect for helping customers choose their preferred option.
negative_prompt: messy arrangement, overlapping products, inconsistent lighting across items, shadows cast between products, dirty surface, reflection glare, products not level, cluttered, more than 6 items crowded together
style: Clean catalog photography, comparison chart aesthetic, product lineup photography, minimalist retail display, IKEA catalog style
composition: Products arranged in neat row (3-4 items) or 2x2 grid, consistent spacing, flat lay from above or slight 15-degree angle, equal visual weight per item, clean edges
lighting: Even studio lighting across all items, soft multiple-source lighting eliminating cross-shadows, diffused overhead key with side fill, no hotspots
color_palette: Clean neutral surface (white or light gray), product colors naturally represented across all variants, consistent exposure across the frame, slight warm tint for skin-friendly products
